road: Long time ago, one red road dey pass between two compound, and anybody wey use am dey pass one junction.
friends: Na for that road two friends dey live, dem dey farm together side by side and dem dey go market like person wey be one.
friends.ask: Who be the two friends sef?
walk: Every market morning, dem dey waka go together, dey yarn all through the journey.
oath: Dem swear say nothing for this world fit come between dem. No quarrel. Not even god sef.
day: One bright day, dem start their journey as usual, each person dey him own side of the road.
waiting: Na for crossroads one person dey wait.
eshu: Na Eshu, small god, the one wey dey carry message and trouble between heaven and earth.
hat: For im head, one tall hat dey. One side red. The other side white.
between: E waka enter road and pass straight between the two friends.
passed: E no greet them. E no stop. E just pass, and sand cover where E pass.
red: The friend for left side talk say, the red hat fine well well o.
white: Di padi wey dey for right side stop. E say, na white di hat be.
white.ask: Wetin make di two padi dem come dey argue?
quarrel: Dem stand for road dey yarn, each person dey feel say di oda person don blind.
market: Before dem reach market, di fight don loud sotay everybody for town hear am.
fight: Word turn to shout, and shout turn to full fight for sand.
watch: People leave dia market place come watch two padi wey wan prove colour.
evening: Dat evening, di town carry dem go shrine make dem settle di matter.
there: Eshu don already dey dia, dey sit down for fire side, and e dey laugh.
there.ask: Wetin dey make Eshu laugh so?
turned: E lift the hat up and turn am slowly, one time, so everybody face fit see am.
both: Red for one side. White for the other side. Both friends talk true.
both.ask: How the hat come get two colours at the same time?
teaching: Eshu con talk say, I waka pass una middle, and each person just see the side wey I give am.
teaching.ask: Wetin Eshu come dey teach them self?
same-road: Una forget say una still dey walk the same road.
calabash: E put one calabash of palm wine for their middle.
laughed: Di two padi look di hat, den dem look each other, and dem laugh sotey dem come sit down.
morning: By morning, dem don enter road again, dey waka like person wey be one.
offering: Na im make am say, for crossroads, people still dey put small tin down for Eshu.
gates: Na the same sand their gate dey open to.
bowl: Dɛm join hand hoe ground, chop join from one bowl.
prices: Dem talk about rain and market price.
boys: People laugh. Na wetin old padi dey always talk.
louder: One person shout am pass, make road hear am.
listening: Na small god dey hear am.
smiled: E smile sake sey dem give am work.
sight: Na im crossroad come show face.
bones: Cowry wey dem tie for rope dey shake for im staff.
hung: Red dust dey hang for air.
sure: Na di friend wey dey left hand side trust im own eyes.
strange: Di friend for right side squeeze face.
looking: Na red, di first one talk.
sun: Na white, di second one talk.
liar: Each one call di other person liar.
step: Not one of them cross go join the other person side.
sellers: People wey dey sell look up from their goods.
only: Na only each other dem hear.
neighbours: Even still, dem no gree at all.
followed: Half of di town waka follow dem for back, dem carry torch.
known: Na im hat still dey im head.
white-side: White come round for the left friend.
red-side: Red come round for the right friend.
quiet: Di shrine come quiet sake of dat.
pot: Even di fire be like say e dey listen.
whole: True, e talk. No be di whole hat.
drink: Make una drink from one cup, e talk so.
town: The town laugh, and everything finish.
head: One of dem touch im own head, like say e dey find hat, come smile.
